summary: xq-luthor is a contract-first hub: hand-authored openapi/<service>/openapi.yaml and database_schema/schema.sql (PostgreSQL DDL) are source of truth; generated nodejs/python/java clients are committed alongside so consumers need no codegen toolchain.

ADR 0001 (accepted, pending human review at Foundation checkpoint): openapi-typescript+openapi-fetch (node), openapi-python-client (python), openapi-generator okhttp-gson (java); kysely-codegen, sqlacodegen, jOOQ for DDL cells. All DDL tools introspect a live DB via ephemeral pinned Postgres.
Superseded: preamble no longer uses a Docker container; it runs embedded PostgreSQL via postgresql-binaries==16.15.0 through uv. See lesson-embedded-postgres-for-ddl-codegen.

nodejs clients publish to npm on GitHub Packages (npm.pkg.github.com); java to Maven (maven.pkg.github.com); versions match contract version dirs. python installs via uv git install from repo tags (GitHub Packages has no python support); git tag naming convention TBD in Task 11.
Superseded: Docker image digest pinning no longer applies; ephemeral Postgres is now embedded postgresql-binaries==16.15.0 via uv. See lesson-deterministic-regen-gate-v2.

kysely-codegen/sqlacodegen/jOOQ introspect a live database. Preamble (scripts/pg-ephemeral.sh -> pg-ephemeral.py) runs embedded PostgreSQL via `uv run --with postgresql-binaries==16.15.0`; no Docker daemon required. schema.sql must still apply cleanly to a fresh empty Postgres.

Conventions require byte-identical regen from same contract + pinned tool. Determinism needs all of {tool version, postgresql-binaries version (16.15.0, pinned in pg-ephemeral.sh), JDK/Node/Python versions} pinned and recorded; no Docker image digest involved anymore.
